review_text: Sunny Tea House is hands down my favorite boba spot in San Jose! Super fast service and the crew is always so welcoming. The boba was chewy and fresh!
🧋在San Jose挖到宝藏奶茶啦！杨枝甘露拍照巨出片，少糖配比超级绝，奶香浓郁清爽不腻～必须安利给所有姐妹！
Really clean store and great modern vibe. Ordered the Roasted Oolong Milk Tea at 50% sugar. Perfect tea aroma and boba consistency.
下午茶点单不到3分钟就拿到了，出餐速度感人！店员小哥态度超好，拯救了社畜的一天～
The drink presentation is gorgeous! Tried their signature fruit tea, colorful and full of fresh mango and passionfruit. 10/10.
Decent tea flavor, but the tapioca was slightly softer than I prefer. Service was very prompt though.
店面装修超级干净明亮，原木风太戳我了！拍了二十分钟照片根本停不下来，奶茶不仅好看还超好喝✨
Authentic Taiwanese style boba right in the South Bay! Staff explained the sweetness levels patiently. Will be coming back regularly.
黑糖珍珠鲜奶绝了！珍珠Q弹筋道，出餐特别快，不用大排长龙太幸福了！
Super impressed by the clean aesthetic and quick turnaround during the afternoon rush. Mango Pomelo Sago is a must-try!
Staff was super patient answering questions about dairy-free options. Oat milk substitute was rich and smooth.
湾区下午茶天花板！这杯芝士葡萄颜值太能打了，芝士奶盖浓郁咸香，搭配新鲜葡萄果肉层次感拉满！
Hands down the best tea leaves used in San Jose. You can genuinely taste the deep oolong aroma rather than artificial syrups.
Fast, friendly, and refreshing! Even with 6 people in line, my drink came out in under 4 minutes.
店员小姐姐笑容巨甜，还送了可爱的小贴纸！杯套和杯身设计非常有质感，发朋友圈被问爆了！
Nice seating area to get some work done. Music wasn't too loud and tables were wiped clean.
The brown sugar boba milk was warm at the bottom and icy on top. Perfectly balanced texture.
少冰微糖刚刚好，茶香和奶味完美融合，店员还主动提醒珍珠刚出锅注意搅拌，太贴心了！
The shop is super clean and fast, but the line was a bit confusing outside on the sidewalk.
夏天来一杯满杯红柚太解渴了！红柚果肉颗粒分明，颜值爆表，打卡圣地无误！
Top-notch customer service. Store manager was very attentive and the seating area is cozy.
High quality boba and lightning-fast preparation. Definitely in my top 3 boba shops in the Bay Area.
被朋友安利来的，芋泥波波奶茶太真材实料了，满满半杯手打芋泥，喝完巨有饱腹感！
The aesthetic of this shop is so Instagrammable! Drinks taste just as good as they look.
Quick pickup on a Saturday afternoon. Staff handled the crowd gracefully.
店里冷气很足，座位之间间距舒适。扫码碰一下点单出餐巨快，体验感极度丝滑！
The matcha latte with boba was rich and not overly sweet. Very serene and cozy atmosphere.
Friendly greeting as soon as I stepped in. Ordered on their NFC tap system and got my drink in 3 mins.
招牌多肉葡萄实名夸赞！渐变色太梦幻了，吸一口满满都是爽脆葡萄肉和爽滑茶冻！
Consistently great boba texture every single visit. Keep up the high standard!
